title: XOR Over a Range
prompt:
**Bài toán.** T ≤ 10^4 queries of n ≤ 10^9: print the XOR of all
integers 1..n.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ T ≤ 10^4; 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^9.

The pattern repeats with period 4 — a loop to n will time out.

tests.name: small
large n
T=10000 all max — kill
tests.hint: 10000 × 10^9 loop iterations = 10^13 — far beyond the sandbox; the O(1) period-4 table answers instantly.
